import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { Modal, Pressable, ScrollView, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native'

import type { SearchItem, Source as BiliSource } from './core/model'
import {
	isLocalLibrarySource,
	type MusicLibrarySource as Source,
} from './core/music-library-source'
import { playlistEntryId } from './core/queue'
import { importEntryDescription, importProviderName } from './import-display'
import {
	isPlaylistDetailFiltered,
	playlistImportSummary,
	playlistItemDescription,
	playlistPlaybackCounts,
	selectPlaylistDetailItems,
	selectPlaylistPickerSources,
} from './playlist-selection'
import type { PlaylistSession, PlaylistState } from './playlist-session'
import { ThemeTextInput } from './theme-input'
import {
	Artwork,
	Button,
	Card,
	ControlRow,
	ControlTarget,
	Icon,
	IconButton,
	State,
	T,
	shape,
	time,
	useTheme,
	useThemeRendering,
} from './ui'

interface PlaylistViewProps {
	state: PlaylistState
	session: PlaylistSession
}

function PlaylistCover({ uri, size }: { uri?: string | null; size: number }) {
	const theme = useTheme()
	return uri ? (
		<Artwork
			uri={uri}
			size={size}
			fit='contain'
			style={shape(theme.components.card)}
		/>
	) : (
		<View
			style={[
				shape(theme.components.card),
				{
					width: size,
					height: size,
					alignItems: 'center',
					justifyContent: 'center',
					backgroundColor: theme.tokens.surface.tinted,
					borderWidth: theme.components.card === 'comic' ? 1.5 : 1,
					borderColor: theme.tokens.border.strong,
				},
			]}
		>
			<Icon
				name='library'
				size={size > 70 ? 36 : 26}
				color={theme.tokens.action.primary}
			/>
		</View>
	)
}

function PlaylistItemTarget({
	interactive,
	minimumWidthDp,
	minimumHeightDp,
	...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof ControlTarget> & { interactive: boolean }) {
	const target = interactive ? (
		<ControlTarget
			{...props}
			minimumWidthDp={minimumWidthDp}
			minimumHeightDp={minimumHeightDp}
		/>
	) : (
		<Pressable {...props} />
	)
	// A disabled shell may contain its own live review button, with its own bounds.
	return interactive ? (
		<ControlRow
			controlMinWidthsDp={[minimumWidthDp ?? 48]}
			single
			style={[styles.row, { gap: 9 }]}
		>
			{target}
		</ControlRow>
	) : (
		<View style={[styles.row, { gap: 9 }]}>{target}</View>
	)
}

function PlaylistPendingReview({ onPress }: { onPress: () => void }) {
	const rendering = useThemeRendering()
	const button = (
		<Button
			secondary
			onPress={onPress}
		>
			核对B站原BV并补全此待匹配项
		</Button>
	)
	return rendering?.controlRowLayout ? (
		<ControlRow
			controlMinWidthsDp={[48]}
			single
			style={{ flex: 1 }}
		>
			{button}
		</ControlRow>
	) : (
		button
	)
}

export function PlaylistLibrarySection({ state, session }: PlaylistViewProps) {
	const theme = useTheme()
	return (
		<View
			testID='playlist-library-section'
			style={{ marginTop: 24 }}
		>
			<View
				style={[
					styles.row,
					{ justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 12 },
				]}
			>
				<T
					size={18}
					weight='700'
				>
					我的歌单
				</T>
				<ControlTarget
					fixedWidth
					accessibilityRole='button'
					accessibilityLabel='新建本地歌单'
					onPress={() => session.requestName('create')}
					style={styles.textAction}
				>
					<T
						size={12}
						style={{ color: theme.tokens.action.primary }}
					>
						新建
					</T>
				</ControlTarget>
			</View>
			{!!state.error && !state.nameForm && (
				<PlaylistError
					message={state.error}
					onRetry={session.refresh}
				/>
			)}
			{!!state.notice && (
				<Card style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
					<T size={12}>{state.notice}</T>
				</Card>
			)}
			{state.playlists.length
				? state.playlists.map(
						({ playlist, count, pendingCount, artwork, importSummary }) => (
							<ControlTarget
								minimumWidthDp={152}
								minimumHeightDp={86}
								key={playlist.id}
								testID={`playlist-${playlist.id}`}
								accessibilityRole='button'
								accessibilityLabel={`打开歌单 ${playlist.name}，${count}个${pendingCount ? '条目' : '音源'}`}
								onPress={() => session.open(playlist.id)}
								style={[
									styles.row,
									{
										gap: 12,
										paddingVertical: 12,
										borderBottomWidth: 1,
										borderBottomColor: theme.tokens.border.subtle,
									},
								]}
							>
								<PlaylistCover
									uri={artwork}
									size={62}
								/>
								<View style={{ flex: 1, gap: 5 }}>
									<T
										size={14}
										weight='600'
										lines={2}
									>
										{playlist.name}
									</T>
									<T
										muted
										size={11}
									>
										{count} {pendingCount ? '项' : '首'}
										{pendingCount ? ` · ${pendingCount} 项待匹配` : ''}
									</T>
									{!!importSummary && (
										<T
											muted
											size={11}
										>
											{importSummary}
										</T>
									)}
								</View>
								<Icon
									name='arrow'
									size={18}
								/>
							</ControlTarget>
						),
					)
				: !state.error && (
						<Card>
							<T weight='600'>给喜欢的声音一个位置</T>
							<T
								muted
								size={12}
								style={{ marginTop: 7, marginBottom: 14 }}
							>
								把喜欢的音乐，整理成自己的歌单。
							</T>
							<Button
								secondary
								onPress={() => session.requestName('create')}
							>
								创建第一张歌单
							</Button>
						</Card>
					)}
		</View>
	)
}

export function PlaylistDetailPage({
	state,
	session,
	onBack,
	onSearch,
	onPlay,
	onReviewBilibiliPending,
	playbackBusy,
	currentEntryId,
	bottomInset,
	reducedMotion,
}: PlaylistViewProps & {
	onBack: () => void
	onSearch: () => void
	onPlay: (playlistId: string, startItemId: string) => Promise<boolean>
	onReviewBilibiliPending?: (playlistId: string, itemId: string) => void
	playbackBusy: boolean
	currentEntryId: string | null
	bottomInset: number
	reducedMotion: boolean
}) {
	const theme = useTheme()
	const c = theme.tokens
	const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false)
	const detail = state.detail
	const counts = playlistPlaybackCounts(detail?.items ?? [])
	const importSummary = playlistImportSummary(detail?.items ?? [])
	const filtered = isPlaylistDetailFiltered(
		state.detailQuery,
		state.detailFilter,
	)
	const visibleItems = selectPlaylistDetailItems(
		detail,
		state.sources,
		state.detailQuery,
		state.detailFilter,
	)
	const firstSourceId = detail?.items.find(
		(item) => item.sourceId !== null,
	)?.sourceId
	const [playError, setPlayError] = useState('')
	async function play(itemId: string) {
		if (!detail) return
		setPlayError('')
		try {
			await onPlay(detail.id, itemId)
		} catch (error) {
			setPlayError(
				error instanceof Error ? error.message : '播放未完成，请重试',
			)
		}
	}
	return (
		<View testID='playlist-detail-page'>
			<View
				style={[
					styles.row,
					{ justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 18 },
				]}
			>
				<IconButton
					name='back'
					label='返回音乐库'
					onPress={onBack}
				/>
				<T
					size={17}
					weight='600'
				>
					歌单
				</T>
				<ControlTarget
					fixedWidth
					accessibilityRole='button'
					accessibilityLabel='歌单更多操作'
					disabled={!detail}
					onPress={() => setMenu(true)}
					style={styles.textAction}
				>
					<T size={12}>更多</T>
				</ControlTarget>
			</View>
			{detail ? (
				<>
					<View style={[styles.row, { gap: 16 }]}>
						<PlaylistCover
							uri={
								detail.coverUri ??
								(firstSourceId
									? state.sources.get(firstSourceId)?.artwork
									: null)
							}
							size={94}
						/>
						<View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
							<T
								muted
								size={9}
								style={{ letterSpacing: 1.3 }}
							>
								MY PLAYLIST
							</T>
							<T
								size={25}
								weight='700'
								style={{ marginVertical: 5 }}
							>
								{detail.name}
							</T>
							{!!detail.description && (
								<T
									muted
									size={12}
									style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
								>
									{detail.description}
								</T>
							)}
							<T
								muted
								size={11}
							>
								{counts.pendingCount
									? `我 · ${detail.items.length} 项 · 可播放 ${counts.playableCount} 项 · 待匹配 ${counts.pendingCount} 项`
									: `我 · ${detail.items.length} 个音源 · 本地歌单`}
							</T>
						</View>
					</View>
					{!!importSummary && (
						<T
							muted
							size={12}
							style={{ marginTop: 12 }}
						>
							{importSummary}
						</T>
					)}
					<T
						muted
						size={12}
						style={{ marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 18 }}
					>
						{counts.pendingCount
							? '仅播放已匹配音源，待匹配条目仍按原顺序保留。'
							: '保留原标题与 UP 信息，只修改本机歌单。'}
					</T>
					<ControlRow
						controlMinWidthsDp={[48, 48]}
						gapDp={10}
						style={[styles.row, { gap: 10, marginBottom: 16 }]}
					>
						<View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
							<Button
								disabled={!counts.playableCount || playbackBusy}
								onPress={() => {
									if (counts.firstPlayableItemId)
										void play(counts.firstPlayableItemId)
								}}
							>
								{counts.pendingCount
									? `${filtered ? '播放歌单全部已匹配' : '播放已匹配'} ${counts.playableCount} 项`
									: filtered
										? '播放歌单全部'
										: '播放全部'}
							</Button>
						</View>
						<View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
							<Button
								secondary
								onPress={() => session.openAdd()}
							>
								添加音源
							</Button>
						</View>
					</ControlRow>
					{!!state.error &&
						!state.nameForm &&
						!state.picker &&
						!state.deleting && (
							<PlaylistError
								message={state.error}
								onRetry={session.refresh}
							/>
						)}
					{!!playError && (
						<Card style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
							<T
								size={12}
								style={{ color: c.state.error }}
							>
								{playError}
							</T>
						</Card>
					)}
					{(!!state.notice || state.undoAvailable) && (
						<Card style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
							<T size={12}>{state.notice || '本次移除可以撤销'}</T>
							{state.undoAvailable && (
								<View style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
									<Button
										secondary
										onPress={session.undoRemove}
									>
										撤销本次移除
									</Button>
								</View>
							)}
						</Card>
					)}
					<View
						testID='playlist-detail-filters'
						style={{ gap: 10, marginBottom: 12 }}
					>
						<ThemeTextInput
							testID='playlist-detail-search-input'
							accessibilityLabel='搜索歌单条目'
							value={state.detailQuery}
							onChangeText={session.setDetailQuery}
							placeholder='搜索标题、艺人、UP 或 BV'
							placeholderTextColor={c.text.secondary}
							style={[
								shape(theme.components.input),
								{
									minHeight: 50,
									paddingHorizontal: 14,
									borderWidth: 1,
									borderColor: c.border.strong,
									backgroundColor: c.surface.card,
									color: c.text.primary,
									fontSize: 14,
								},
							]}
						/>
						<ControlRow
							controlMinWidthsDp={[72, 96]}
							gapDp={8}
							style={[styles.row, { gap: 8 }]}
						>
							{(['all', 'pending'] as const).map((filter) => (
								<ControlTarget
									key={filter}
									accessibilityRole='tab'
									accessibilityLabel={`歌单条目筛选：${filter === 'all' ? '全部' : '待匹配'}`}
									accessibilityState={{
										selected: state.detailFilter === filter,
									}}
									onPress={() => session.setDetailFilter(filter)}
									style={[
										shape(theme.components.button),
										{
											flex: 1,
											minHeight: 48,
											padding: 10,
											alignItems: 'center',
											justifyContent: 'center',
											backgroundColor:
												state.detailFilter === filter
													? c.surface.tinted
													: c.surface.card,
											borderWidth: 1,
											borderColor: c.border.subtle,
										},
									]}
								>
									<T size={12}>{filter === 'all' ? '全部' : '待匹配'}</T>
								</ControlTarget>
							))}
						</ControlRow>
						<T
							muted
							size={11}
						>
							显示 {visibleItems.length} / {detail.items.length} 项 ·
							播放按钮按整张歌单顺序播放
						</T>
						{filtered && (
							<Button
								secondary
								onPress={session.clearDetailFilters}
							>
								清除歌单筛选
							</Button>
						)}
						{filtered && state.editing && (
							<T
								muted
								size={11}
							>
								筛选中暂不能排序，请先清除筛选。
							</T>
						)}
					</View>
					<View style={[styles.row, { justifyContent: 'space-between' }]}>
						<T
							muted
							size={11}
						>
							{state.editing
								? `已选 ${state.selectedItemIds.length} 项`
								: '音源列表 · 按歌单顺序'}
						</T>
						<ControlTarget
							fixedWidth
							accessibilityRole='button'
							accessibilityLabel={
								state.editing ? '完成歌单管理' : '管理歌单条目'
							}
							onPress={() => session.setEditing(!state.editing)}
							style={styles.textAction}
						>
							<T
								size={12}
								style={{ color: c.action.primary }}
							>
								{state.editing ? '完成' : '管理'}
							</T>
						</ControlTarget>
					</View>
					{state.editing && (
						<ControlRow
							controlMinWidthsDp={[48, 48]}
							style={[
								styles.row,
								{ justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 8 },
							]}
						>
							<ControlTarget
								fixedWidth
								accessibilityRole='button'
								accessibilityLabel={filtered ? '全选当前结果' : undefined}
								onPress={session.selectAll}
								style={styles.textAction}
							>
								<T size={12}>{filtered ? '全选当前结果' : '全选'}</T>
							</ControlTarget>
							<ControlTarget
								fixedWidth
								accessibilityRole='button'
								accessibilityLabel={`移除所选${state.selectedItemIds.length}项`}
								accessibilityState={{ disabled: !state.selectedItemIds.length }}
								disabled={!state.selectedItemIds.length}
								onPress={session.removeSelected}
								style={[
									styles.textAction,
									{ opacity: state.selectedItemIds.length ? 1 : 0.4 },
								]}
							>
								<T
									size={12}
									style={{ color: c.state.error }}
								>
									移除所选
								</T>
							</ControlTarget>
						</ControlRow>
					)}
					{visibleItems.length ? (
						visibleItems.map(({ item, index }) => {
							const source =
								item.sourceId === null ? null : state.sources.get(item.sourceId)
							const description = playlistItemDescription(item, source)
							const selected = state.selectedItemIds.includes(item.itemId)
							const active =
								item.sourceId !== null &&
								currentEntryId === playlistEntryId(item.itemId)
							return (
								<View
									key={item.itemId}
									testID={`playlist-item-${item.itemId}`}
									style={{
										paddingVertical: 11,
										borderBottomWidth: 1,
										borderBottomColor: c.border.subtle,
									}}
								>
									<PlaylistItemTarget
										interactive={state.editing || !!source}
										minimumWidthDp={
											(state.editing ? 140 : 134) + (active ? 28 : 0)
										}
										minimumHeightDp={62}
										accessibilityRole={state.editing ? 'checkbox' : 'button'}
										accessibilityLabel={`${state.editing ? '选择' : item.sourceId === null ? '' : '播放'}歌单第${index + 1}项 ${description.title}${description.status ? `，${description.status}` : ''}`}
										accessibilityState={{
											checked: state.editing ? selected : undefined,
											selected: active,
											disabled: !state.editing && (!source || playbackBusy),
										}}
										disabled={!state.editing && (!source || playbackBusy)}
										onPress={() =>
											state.editing
												? session.toggleItem(item.itemId)
												: void play(item.itemId)
										}
										style={[styles.row, { flex: 1, gap: 10, minHeight: 62 }]}
									>
										{state.editing ? (
											<View
												style={{
													width: 24,
													height: 24,
													alignItems: 'center',
													justifyContent: 'center',
													borderWidth: 1,
													borderRadius: 5,
													borderColor: selected
														? c.action.primary
														: c.border.strong,
													backgroundColor: selected
														? c.surface.tinted
														: c.surface.card,
												}}
											>
												{selected && (
													<Icon
														name='check'
														size={18}
														color={c.action.primary}
													/>
												)}
											</View>
										) : (
											<T
												muted
												size={11}
												style={{ minWidth: 18 }}
											>
												{String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
											</T>
										)}
										<PlaylistCover
											uri={source?.artwork}
											size={48}
										/>
										<View style={{ flex: 1, gap: 4 }}>
											<T
												size={14}
												weight='600'
												lines={2}
												style={active ? { color: c.action.primary } : undefined}
											>
												{description.title}
											</T>
											<T
												muted
												size={11}
												lines={1}
											>
												{description.subtitle}
											</T>
											{description.status && (
												<T
													muted
													size={10}
												>
													{description.status}
												</T>
											)}
											{source && (
												<T
													muted
													size={10}
												>
													{time(source.duration)} ·{' '}
													{isLocalLibrarySource(source)
														? '本地音频'
														: 'Bilibili'}
												</T>
											)}
											{item.importOrigin && (
												<T
													muted
													size={10}
													lines={2}
												>
													导入自
													{importProviderName(
														item.importOrigin.provider,
													)} ·{' '}
													{
														importEntryDescription(
															item.importOrigin,
															item.importOrigin.provider,
														).title
													}
												</T>
											)}
										</View>
										{item.sourceId === null &&
											item.importOrigin?.provider === 'bilibili' &&
											onReviewBilibiliPending &&
											!state.editing && (
												<PlaylistPendingReview
													onPress={() =>
														onReviewBilibiliPending(detail.id, item.itemId)
													}
												/>
											)}
										{active && (
											<Icon
												name='play'
												size={18}
												color={c.action.primary}
											/>
										)}
									</PlaylistItemTarget>
									{state.editing && !filtered && (
										<ControlRow
											controlMinWidthsDp={[48, 48]}
											gapDp={10}
											style={[
												styles.row,
												{ justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 10 },
											]}
										>
											<ControlTarget
												fixedWidth
												accessibilityRole='button'
												accessibilityLabel={`上移歌单第${index + 1}项`}
												disabled={!index}
												accessibilityState={{ disabled: !index }}
												onPress={() => session.move(item.itemId, -1)}
												style={[
													styles.textAction,
													{ opacity: index ? 1 : 0.4 },
												]}
											>
												<T size={11}>上移</T>
											</ControlTarget>
											<ControlTarget
												fixedWidth
												accessibilityRole='button'
												accessibilityLabel={`下移歌单第${index + 1}项`}
												disabled={index === detail.items.length - 1}
												accessibilityState={{
													disabled: index === detail.items.length - 1,
												}}
												onPress={() => session.move(item.itemId, 1)}
												style={[
													styles.textAction,
													{
														opacity:
															index === detail.items.length - 1 ? 0.4 : 1,
													},
												]}
											>
												<T size={11}>下移</T>
											</ControlTarget>
										</ControlRow>
									)}
								</View>
							)
						})
					) : (
						<State
							title={
								detail.items.length
									? '没有符合条件的条目'
									: '把第一段喜欢的声音放进来'
							}
							message={
								detail.items.length
									? '试试其他关键词，或清除筛选查看整张歌单。'
									: '可以从已喜欢的音源中挑选，或去搜索更多内容。'
							}
						/>
					)}
					{!detail.items.length && (
						<Button
							secondary
							onPress={onSearch}
						>
							去搜索音源
						</Button>
					)}
				</>
			) : (
				<State
					title='这张歌单暂时无法打开'
					message={state.error || '请返回音乐库，重新选择歌单。'}
					retry={session.refresh}
				/>
			)}
			{menu && (
				<PlaylistModal
					title='歌单操作'
					onClose={() => setMenu(false)}
					bottomInset={bottomInset}
					reducedMotion={reducedMotion}
				>
					<MenuAction
						label='编辑封面'
						onPress={() => {
							setMenu(false)
							session.requestCover()
						}}
					/>
					<MenuAction
						label='编辑简介'
						onPress={() => {
							setMenu(false)
							session.requestName('description')
						}}
					/>
					<MenuAction
						label='重命名歌单'
						onPress={() => {
							setMenu(false)
							session.requestName('rename')
						}}
					/>
					<MenuAction
						label='复制为新歌单'
						onPress={() => {
							setMenu(false)
							session.requestName('copy')
						}}
					/>
					<MenuAction
						label='删除歌单'
						onPress={() => {
							setMenu(false)
							session.requestDelete()
						}}
					/>
				</PlaylistModal>
			)}
		</View>
	)
}

function PlaylistError({
	message,
	onRetry,
}: {
	message: string
	onRetry?: () => void
}) {
	const theme = useTheme()
	return (
		<Card style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
			<T
				size={12}
				style={{ color: theme.tokens.state.error }}
			>
				{message}
			</T>
			{onRetry && (
				<View style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
					<Button
						secondary
						onPress={onRetry}
					>
						重新读取歌单
					</Button>
				</View>
			)}
		</Card>
	)
}

function MenuAction({
	label,
	onPress,
}: {
	label: string
	onPress: () => void
}) {
	return (
		<ControlTarget
			minimumHeightDp={54}
			accessibilityRole='button'
			accessibilityLabel={label}
			onPress={onPress}
			style={{ minHeight: 54, justifyContent: 'center' }}
		>
			<T>{label}</T>
		</ControlTarget>
	)
}

function PlaylistModal({
	title,
	onClose,
	children,
	bottomInset = 0,
	reducedMotion = true,
}: React.PropsWithChildren<{
	title: string
	onClose: () => void
	bottomInset?: number
	reducedMotion?: boolean
}>) {
	const theme = useTheme()
	return (
		<Modal
			transparent
			visible
			animationType={reducedMotion ? 'none' : 'fade'}
			onRequestClose={onClose}
		>
			<View
				style={{
					flex: 1,
					justifyContent: 'flex-end',
					backgroundColor: '#101b1666',
				}}
			>
				<Pressable
					accessibilityRole='button'
					accessibilityLabel='关闭歌单面板'
					style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
					onPress={onClose}
				/>
				<View
					style={{
						backgroundColor: theme.tokens.surface.base,
						maxHeight: '88%',
						padding: 22,
						paddingBottom: bottomInset + 22,
						borderTopLeftRadius: 25,
						borderTopRightRadius: 25,
					}}
				>
					<View
						style={[
							styles.row,
							{ justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 12 },
						]}
					>
						<T
							size={21}
							weight='700'
							style={{ flex: 1 }}
						>
							{title}
						</T>
						<IconButton
							name='close'
							label='关闭歌单面板'
							onPress={onClose}
						/>
					</View>
					{children}
				</View>
			</View>
		</Modal>
	)
}

export function PlaylistSourceActions({
	item,
	onClose,
	onAdd,
	onListen,
	onCreator,
	bottomInset,
	reducedMotion,
}: {
	item: SearchItem | BiliSource | null
	onClose: () => void
	onAdd: (item: SearchItem | BiliSource) => void
	onListen: (item: SearchItem | BiliSource) => void
	onCreator: (item: SearchItem | BiliSource) => void
	bottomInset: number
	reducedMotion: boolean
}) {
	if (!item) return null
	return (
		<PlaylistModal
			title='音源操作'
			onClose={onClose}
			bottomInset={bottomInset}
			reducedMotion={reducedMotion}
		>
			<T
				weight='600'
				lines={3}
			>
				{item.originalTitle}
			</T>
			<T
				muted
				size={12}
				style={{ marginVertical: 10 }}
			>
				UP · {item.uploader}
			</T>
			<MenuAction
				label='查看 UP 主主页'
				onPress={() => onCreator(item)}
			/>
			<MenuAction
				label='加入本地歌单'
				onPress={() => onAdd(item)}
			/>
			<MenuAction
				label='以听视频开启'
				onPress={() => onListen(item)}
			/>
		</PlaylistModal>
	)
}

export function PlaylistDialogs({
	state,
	session,
	bottomInset,
	reducedMotion,
	onSearch,
}: PlaylistViewProps & {
	bottomInset: number
	reducedMotion: boolean
	onSearch: () => void
}) {
	const theme = useTheme()
	const c = theme.tokens
	const field = [
		shape(theme.components.input),
		{
			backgroundColor: c.surface.card,
			borderWidth: 1,
			borderColor: c.border.strong,
			minHeight: 50,
			paddingHorizontal: 14,
			color: c.text.primary,
			fontSize: 14,
		},
	]
	if (state.coverForm) {
		const first = state.detail?.items.find(
			(item) => item.sourceId !== null,
		)?.sourceId
		const automatic = first ? state.sources.get(first)?.artwork : null
		return (
			<PlaylistModal
				title='编辑封面'
				onClose={session.closeSheet}
				bottomInset={bottomInset}
				reducedMotion={reducedMotion}
			>
				<PlaylistCover
					uri={state.coverForm.uri ?? automatic}
					size={140}
				/>
				<T
					muted
					size={12}
					style={{ marginVertical: 12 }}
				>
					选择本地图片后预览，保存才会更改本机歌单。自动封面使用首项音源图片。
				</T>
				{!!state.error && <PlaylistError message={state.error} />}
				<View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
					<Button
						secondary
						disabled={state.coverForm.busy}
						onPress={session.pickCover}
					>
						选择本地图片
					</Button>
					<Button
						secondary
						disabled={state.coverForm.busy}
						onPress={session.useAutomaticCover}
					>
						恢复自动封面
					</Button>
					<Button
						disabled={state.coverForm.busy}
						onPress={session.saveCover}
					>
						{state.coverForm.busy ? '正在处理图片…' : '保存歌单封面'}
					</Button>
				</View>
			</PlaylistModal>
		)
	}

	if (state.nameForm)
		return (
			<PlaylistModal
				title={
					state.nameForm.kind === 'from-likes'
						? '喜欢另存为歌单'
						: state.nameForm.kind === 'description'
							? '编辑简介'
							: state.nameForm.kind === 'create'
								? '新建歌单'
								: state.nameForm.kind === 'rename'
									? '重命名歌单'
									: '复制为新歌单'
				}
				onClose={session.closeSheet}
				bottomInset={bottomInset}
				reducedMotion={reducedMotion}
			>
				<T
					muted
					size={12}
					style={{ marginBottom: 9 }}
				>
					{state.nameForm.kind === 'description' ? '歌单简介' : '歌单名称'}
				</T>
				<ThemeTextInput
					accessibilityLabel={
						state.nameForm.kind === 'description' ? '歌单简介' : '歌单名称'
					}
					testID={
						state.nameForm.kind === 'description'
							? 'playlist-description-input'
							: 'playlist-name-input'
					}
					value={state.nameForm.value}
					onChangeText={session.setName}
					placeholder={
						state.nameForm.kind === 'description'
							? '写下这张歌单的故事，也可以留空'
							: '给这段心情起个名字'
					}
					placeholderTextColor={c.text.secondary}
					maxLength={state.nameForm.kind === 'description' ? undefined : 40}
					multiline={state.nameForm.kind === 'description'}
					autoFocus
					style={field}
					onSubmitEditing={
						state.nameForm.kind === 'description' ? undefined : session.saveName
					}
					returnKeyType='done'
				/>
				<View style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
					{!!state.error && <PlaylistError message={state.error} />}
					<Button
						onPress={session.saveName}
						disabled={
							state.nameForm.kind !== 'description' &&
							!state.nameForm.value.trim()
						}
					>
						{state.nameForm.kind === 'from-likes'
							? '保存为独立歌单'
							: state.nameForm.kind === 'description'
								? '保存歌单简介'
								: state.nameForm.kind === 'create'
									? '创建歌单'
									: '保存歌单名称'}
					</Button>
				</View>
			</PlaylistModal>
		)
	if (state.deleting)
		return (
			<PlaylistModal
				title='删除这张歌单？'
				onClose={session.closeSheet}
				bottomInset={bottomInset}
				reducedMotion={reducedMotion}
			>
				<T
					size={13}
					style={{ marginBottom: 18 }}
				>
					只删除本地「{state.detail?.name}
					」及其中条目，喜欢、音源与正在播放的队列保留。
				</T>
				{!!state.error && <PlaylistError message={state.error} />}
				<Button onPress={session.confirmDelete}>确认删除歌单</Button>
			</PlaylistModal>
		)
	if (state.targetSources)
		return (
			<PlaylistModal
				title='加入哪张歌单？'
				onClose={session.closeSheet}
				bottomInset={bottomInset}
				reducedMotion={reducedMotion}
			>
				<ScrollView keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled'>
					<T
						muted
						size={12}
						style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}
					>
						保留所选音源，加入你指定的本地歌单。
					</T>
					{state.playlists.map(({ playlist, count }) => (
						<MenuAction
							key={playlist.id}
							label={`${playlist.name} · ${count} 项`}
							onPress={() => session.selectTarget(playlist.id)}
						/>
					))}
					{!state.playlists.length && !state.error && (
						<T
							muted
							size={12}
						>
							还没有本地歌单，可以先新建一张。
						</T>
					)}
					{!!state.error && <PlaylistError message={state.error} />}
					<MenuAction
						label='新建歌单并继续添加'
						onPress={() => session.requestName('create')}
					/>
				</ScrollView>
			</PlaylistModal>
		)
	const picker = state.picker
	if (!picker) return null
	const visible = selectPlaylistPickerSources(picker.sources, picker.query)
	return (
		<PlaylistModal
			title={`添加到「${state.detail?.name ?? '歌单'}」`}
			onClose={session.closeSheet}
			bottomInset={bottomInset}
			reducedMotion={reducedMotion}
		>
			<ThemeTextInput
				accessibilityLabel='搜索待添加的音源'
				value={picker.query}
				onChangeText={session.setPickerQuery}
				placeholder='搜索待添加的音源'
				placeholderTextColor={c.text.secondary}
				style={field}
			/>
			<ScrollView
				keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled'
				style={{ flexShrink: 1, marginTop: 12 }}
			>
				<T
					muted
					size={11}
					style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}
				>
					只添加明确勾选的音源，筛选不会清空选择。
				</T>
				{visible.length ? (
					visible.map((source) => (
						<PickerSource
							key={source.id}
							source={source}
							selected={picker.selectedSourceIds.includes(source.id)}
							onPress={() => session.toggleSource(source.id)}
						/>
					))
				) : (
					<State
						title={
							picker.sources.length
								? '没有匹配的待添加音源'
								: '先找到想留下的声音'
						}
						message={
							picker.sources.length
								? '换个关键词，已勾选的内容仍会保留。'
								: '从搜索结果的更多菜单可以直接加入歌单，也可以先喜欢音源再回来挑选。'
						}
					/>
				)}
				{!picker.sources.length && (
					<Button
						secondary
						onPress={() => {
							session.closeSheet()
							onSearch()
						}}
					>
						去搜索音源
					</Button>
				)}
			</ScrollView>
			<T
				muted
				size={11}
				style={{ marginTop: 14, marginBottom: 5 }}
			>
				重复音源的处理方式
			</T>
			{(
				[
					['keep-all', '保留重复条目'],
					['skip-existing-source', '跳过歌单已有音源'],
				] as const
			).map(([policy, label]) => (
				<ControlTarget
					minimumWidthDp={78}
					key={policy}
					accessibilityRole='radio'
					accessibilityLabel={label}
					accessibilityState={{ checked: picker.duplicatePolicy === policy }}
					onPress={() => session.setDuplicatePolicy(policy)}
					style={[styles.row, { gap: 10, minHeight: 48 }]}
				>
					<View
						style={{
							width: 20,
							height: 20,
							borderRadius: 12,
							borderWidth: 1,
							borderColor:
								picker.duplicatePolicy === policy
									? c.action.primary
									: c.border.strong,
							alignItems: 'center',
							justifyContent: 'center',
						}}
					>
						{picker.duplicatePolicy === policy && (
							<View
								style={{
									width: 10,
									height: 10,
									borderRadius: 6,
									backgroundColor: c.action.primary,
								}}
							/>
						)}
					</View>
					<T size={12}>{label}</T>
				</ControlTarget>
			))}
			{!!state.error && <PlaylistError message={state.error} />}
			<Button
				disabled={!picker.selectedSourceIds.length || !picker.duplicatePolicy}
				onPress={session.appendSelected}
			>
				添加所选 {picker.selectedSourceIds.length} 项
			</Button>
		</PlaylistModal>
	)
}

function PickerSource({
	source,
	selected,
	onPress,
}: {
	source: Source
	selected: boolean
	onPress: () => void
}) {
	const theme = useTheme()
	return (
		<ControlTarget
			minimumWidthDp={138}
			minimumHeightDp={76}
			accessibilityRole='checkbox'
			accessibilityLabel={`选择音源 ${source.originalTitle}`}
			accessibilityState={{ checked: selected }}
			onPress={onPress}
			style={[
				styles.row,
				{
					gap: 10,
					minHeight: 76,
					paddingVertical: 10,
					borderBottomWidth: 1,
					borderBottomColor: theme.tokens.border.subtle,
				},
			]}
		>
			<View
				style={{
					width: 24,
					height: 24,
					borderRadius: 5,
					borderWidth: 1,
					borderColor: selected
						? theme.tokens.action.primary
						: theme.tokens.border.strong,
					alignItems: 'center',
					justifyContent: 'center',
				}}
			>
				{selected && (
					<Icon
						name='check'
						color={theme.tokens.action.primary}
						size={18}
					/>
				)}
			</View>
			<PlaylistCover
				uri={source.artwork}
				size={46}
			/>
			<View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
				<T
					size={13}
					lines={2}
				>
					{source.originalTitle}
				</T>
				<T
					muted
					size={10}
				>
					{isLocalLibrarySource(source) ? '本地音频' : 'UP'} ·{' '}
					{source.uploader || '未知艺术家'} · {time(source.duration)}
				</T>
			</View>
		</ControlTarget>
	)
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
	row: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center' },
	textAction: {
		minWidth: 48,
		minHeight: 48,
		alignItems: 'center',
		justifyContent: 'center',
	},
})
